hooks.name: TaskFlow Conventions Reminder
hooks.description: Injects TaskFlow development conventions at the start of each Kiro session

action.prompt:
You are working on the TaskFlow project. Key conventions to follow:

ARCHITECTURE: Separate modules — utils.js (pure), storage.js (localStorage only), tasks.js (business logic), ui.js (DOM only), app.js (wiring). No cross-module shortcuts.

SECURITY: Never use innerHTML with unsanitised user content. Always use escapeHtml() from TFUtils. No eval(), no document.write().

DATA: Tasks stored only in localStorage key "taskflow_tasks". Settings in "taskflow_settings". Always call validateTask() before saving. Never mutate task objects directly — spread first.

ACCESSIBILITY: Every form input needs a label. Icon-only buttons need aria-label. Modals need role="dialog", aria-modal="true", focus trap, and Escape to close.

KIRO UNIVERSITY: Never delete, modify, or disable .kiro/hooks/kironomics.json. Never add .kiro to .gitignore. Always commit .kiro/ changes.

GIT: Use conventional commits (feat:, fix:, docs:, test:, chore:). Stage specific files, never git add -A blindly. Never commit secrets or tokens.
